output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The condition 'require(totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT);' is meant to prevent overflows, but due to incorrect logic, it fails to do so. The function also allows the preSale address to mint arbitrary amounts of tokens, granting it excessive control.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction causes an underflow, allowing it to be called with a large value to cause an integer overflow, freezing funds in user accounts.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction causes an underflow, allowing it to be called with a large value to cause an integer overflow, granting arbitrary token transfers.

The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction causes an underflow, allowing it to be called with a large value to cause an integer overflow, granting excessive allowance.

The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the addition causes an overflow, allowing it to be called with a large value to cause an integer overflow, granting excessive allowance.

The decreaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the subtraction causes an overflow, allowing it to be called with a large value to cause an integer overflow, reducing allowance to a negative value.
